additional_info.subject: 0408247 - ID0408247 - DC/Si-D/EE - [MP / R2 170001448] - Charger losing OCPP connection CRM:00439000739
additional_info.body:
Hello Sakari,
by checking the logs for recent Time find this entry in the logs:
Connection closed because of missing Pong
This does mean that the WebSocket ping from the WebSocketPing didn't receive a Pong response in the expected time (typically around 2 seconds). This is likely the cause of the frequent connection interruptions you're experiencing.
You'll need to investigate why the OCPP Server is not sending the Pong response, or why it's sending the response too late. So i think this is the root cause of the connection issues.
